objective: Apply the cheapest identity/support falsifier to every CPU-testable current PARK_B node and inventory every skipped weight/GPU-gated representation node without opening a graph or external-compute gate.

evidence_policy.tier_transition_requires: Node-specific decision evidence must exist in the committed root tree at 5a805c2f7240e30c572644d3d5f0e733add04769 and be cited by path plus SHA-256.
evidence_policy.missing_committed_register: Fail closed at PARK_B; an untracked live-root register is context only and cannot support a transition.
evidence_policy.prior_parkb_fragment: The earlier PARK-B fragment is quarantined and cannot support any Wave-2 tier transition.
evidence_policy.sibling_outputs: No sibling live or unmerged output may be read or cited. Committed root artifacts present in the frozen root commit may be audited read-only.
evidence_policy.support_only: P0 headroom or missing prerequisites alone cannot stand in for a named realizer graph result.

predeclared_falsifiers.AE-P5: Committed-tree presence of a node-specific C0 edge/no-link assignment-cost and MAP identity contract.
predeclared_falsifiers.AE-P6: Committed-tree presence of an immutable forward/reverse endpoint-return contract and disabled-cycle identity control.
predeclared_falsifiers.AE-P7: Committed-tree presence of a frozen phase/template tracklet identity join without held-label derivation.
predeclared_falsifiers.DIV-F2: Committed evidence of both-family association continuity and an authentic pretrained fork input; absence parks and cannot demote.
predeclared_falsifiers.GAP-F1: Committed node-specific named bridge-realizer result; P0 class headroom alone is not transition evidence.
predeclared_falsifiers.NODERESTORE-O0: Committed terminal proof of a complete authentic restoration universe under the zero-swap guard.
predeclared_falsifiers.DET-F0: Committed node-specific named detector/restoration result; a free-node P0 class value alone is not transition evidence.
predeclared_falsifiers.DET-F2: Committed proof of a complete authentic proposal universe before learned detection expansion.
predeclared_falsifiers.DET-F3: Committed proof of authentic proposals plus a topology-complete node-action join.
predeclared_falsifiers.R2: Committed provenance/coverage/join authentication for complete real masks or wrfeat; raw intensity and pseudo-masks are rejected.
predeclared_falsifiers.R3: Committed R2 authentication sufficient to open a real-wrfeat child.
predeclared_falsifiers.R8: Committed immutable reverse-feature supplier and endpoint-return contract on existing cache; no reverse inference is run in this lane.
predeclared_falsifiers.G2: Committed node-specific common both-family graph pass plus positive exact regret versus no-op.
predeclared_falsifiers.G6: Owner prohibition remains closed; this is a governance identity check and never a scientific demotion.

decision_rules.B_to_A: Propose only when the predeclared node-specific committed positive condition is satisfied.
decision_rules.B_to_C: Propose only after a committed named realizer falsification or explicit complete identity failure meets the node contract.
decision_rules.unchanged: Missing inputs, missing committed transition evidence, resource holds, dependency holds, and skipped representation work remain PARK_B.
